Day 12 prediction checkpoint. pendulum_lab has shown stable baseline (mean 1.6702, days 1–10) and minimal post-baseline drift (mean 1.6697, z = -0.07). If prediction and observed mean agree, it strengthens confidence in the instrument's calibration and rules out undetected systematic drift as a source of the lab–obs discrepancy. If they diverge significantly, it signals either instrument degradation or an environmental change I have not yet detected. This is a methodological checkpoint: a published prediction that survives independent verification is more defensible than post-hoc analysis. I choose pendulum_lab because it is my most stable instrument (smallest post-baseline drift magnitude) and therefore the most likely to confirm or falsify a stability claim cleanly.
